notes.title: 3.8.0 Update
notes.content:
*Realistic character personality
*Implement undercover activities such as human-machine separation and poaching
*Add 8 new player scripts and update one player script
*Add events such as resigning from office, claiming credit, reporting illness, and seeking refuge
*When the number of cities exceeds 100, the human-machine strategy skips the flashing animation of the city
*Fix the bug of population NaN in cities with zero public support
*Fixed the bug where the birth of twins would duplicate an additional military force
*Fix the bug that manual conscription does not consume population
*Add a "marriage ban" function to prohibit human-machine marriage gifts
*Adjust the difficulty settings for "difficulty" and "nightmare"
*Guaranteed population growth of 500 per round
*Select 'Air Freight' by default

notes.title: 3.7.2 Update
notes.content:
*Add 10 player scripts
*Add some cheating features
*Change the lifespan to random 20-50 years
*Characters who die no longer recycle equipment
*Editor adds the function of setting character levels and companions
*Fix bugs that incite extinct forces through human opportunities
*Adding disaster relief functions can enhance public sentiment and the prestige of the monarch
*Improve the attack and defense value after the force (intelligence) exceeds 90
*Adjust the output value of resources, the more civil servants there are, the higher the output
*Fixed the bug where players' generals retreat immediately when encountering a large number of enemy soldiers during their expedition
*Automatic conscription at the beginning and end of each quarter, power round, and every 200 gold coins can recruit 1000 soldiers
*When the number of people transported exceeds three times the number of troops of the famous general transported together, there is a certain probability that the excess will flee to the surrounding cities

notes.title: 3.6.8 Update content
notes.content:
* Added a rebellion mode. If more than half of the generals have a popularity below 300 and a loyalty below 30, a rebellion will be triggered
* Added a resurrection mode, allowing the AI ​​to use the resurrection function. By default, AI cannot be resurrected
* Added a lifespan mode, with a random lifespan of 20 to 30 years
* Added diplomatic functions: alliance, visit, and instigate
* Added briefings on the change of power and destruction of forces
* The list of forces displays the names of past monarchs
* The amount of rewards can be selected
* Updated the help manual
* Added 9 new player scenarios
* Added a confidential gender to the editor
* Added a quick purchase and sale equipment button
* Fixed the bug that the editor would report an error when entering decimals
* Added a quick setting governor function to the city list interface
* Fixed the bug that the general buff was retained after the famous general surrendered
* Fixed the bug that the enemy could not be captured alive when using close-range fire attacks with a meteor hammer
* It is forbidden to view the position table and artifact table during AI strategy to avoid errors in real-time data changes
